result.title: When Does an AUROC Comparison Survive a Change in Population Mix?
result.comment: 30 pages, 5 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
result.summary: Does an AUROC comparison survive a change in the proportions of tasks, populations, or image corruptions? A pooled-AUROC ranking of failure detectors or uncertainty scores describes one particular mix of groups. We study two fixed scores for a common binary target under mixtures of fixed group-conditional laws. Using the cross-group AUC decomposition, we prove that every rational symmetric quadratic comparison geometry is realizable by finite scalar-score distributions. Universal dominance is thus coNP-hard, and even exhaustive checks of every mixture on fewer than $K$ groups can miss a $K$-group reversal. A grid bound gives a dimension-uniform approximation certificate with sharp $1/m$ order. Common score marginals across groups make the comparison numerator linear, with an error envelope for imperfect alignment. These results yield exact finite-bank audits, explicit reversal mixtures and distances, and simultaneous population statements. For failure detection with a frozen ResNet-50 on ImageNet-C, 15 of 18 confidence-score comparisons win in every corruption family on a discovery split, and all 15 are finite-bank certified over all family mixtures on a held-out split; over all 15 corruption types, of 14 discovery winners the corrected grid certifies 10, leaves 3 unresolved, and finds one confirmation reversal of at least 0.05 AUROC. An audit of all 11,019 released Stable LM 2 12B outputs and 35 uncertainty methods finds 66 confirmation-set comparisons that win within all four tasks yet reverse under mixing. Discovery-fitted marginal rank alignment removes all 66; an alignment-error envelope certifies 83 comparisons. Label checks also change several selected reversals. The findings distinguish robustness of frozen scores from robustness after calibration; they do not establish human-error detection, robustness to unseen corruptions, or generalization beyond the evaluated banks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察在任务、人群或图像损坏比例改变时，池化 AUROC 对失败检测器／不确定性分数的比较与排名能否保持；通过跨组 AUC 分解证明任意对称二次比较几何都可由有限标量分数分布实现，给出混合反转构造、有限库审计与近似证书，并在 ImageNet-C 与 Stable LM 2 12B 的分数比较上做实证检查。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文不研究 latent 视觉推理本身，但其「按群体比例池化后比较可能反转」的结论可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益或不确定性阈值比较是否依赖特定样本混合，属评价方法层面的潜在启示，具体迁移需进一步核查。
